en: The postcard shows a tranquil pond or small lake bordered by a decorative iron fence draped with greenery. In the foreground, two people are rowing a small boat on the water. The opposite bank features lush trees and a pavilion or villa-type building with a pointed tower-like roof. The sky is blue and four birds sit on a curved branch at the top of the image. The scene is peaceful and picturesque, conveying a relaxing park or recreational area. The top part of the postcard includes the caption 'Graz. Hilmteich.'
